i.norm: Verifies that "smith" and "smyth" are considered phonetically equivalent by the Match Rating Approach (MRA) algorithm. Both names share the same consonant skeleton (SM-TH) after vowel removal; "y" acts as a vowel substitute, so both encode to the same MRA code and their similarity rating meets the minimum threshold.
"smith" and "smyth" are phonetic variants of the same surname; the MRA algorithm should recognise them as a match.
